name: Anthion's Parting Words
label: Quest
description: Anthion's Parting Words: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.

The only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the medallion back together. Return to Deliana and tell her that Bodley is her only hope for finding the remaining pieces. Speak to her about any rewards you've arranged for.
I, for once, shall rest in peace. I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!

clips.title: Progress
paras: You're back, friend. You must tell me all about what you've found out. But first let us arrange for your reward.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I can't believe our lives are all but forfeit all because of a stupid medallion! And you're sure Anthion mentioned Bodley?
Well, you've done your job so let's get your reward out of the way.
